{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, stripping commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders again (now that revenue is numeric)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Found {len(qa_orders)} QA orders with revenue = 999999.99")

# But we are only interested in 'converted' customers and their age
# So we filter to converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Now, check the age of converted customers
# We must exclude -1 as missing, not a real age
converted_customers_with_age = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of converted customers, excluding -1
mean_age_converted = converted_customers_with_age['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of converted customers: {len(converted_customers)}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age (not -1): {len(converted_customers_with_age)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age_converted:.2f} years")"}
